issue.title: RefsPanelModelTests hidden-library refresh test omits waitForModel closure argument and blocks macOS XCTest compilation
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.land during verification of phase .4. On bob-mac-capture c5d560c5492bf41215bf33213c5b6b51ffeabefa, CI 40113349760 passes lint/build but cannot compile Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsPanelModelTests.swift:2402 in testHiddenLibraryRefreshDoesNotHydrateInspector: contextual type for closure argument list expects 1 argument, which cannot be implicitly ignored. The call is await harness.waitForModel { harness.library.snapshotRefreshGeneration > generation }; the helper at line 5128 accepts @MainActor (RefsPanelModel) -> Bool. Explicitly ignore or name the model parameter, preserving the existing generation predicate and hidden-inspector assertion. git blame attributes the call and test to standalone 72cd721e, before batch 7. Distinct from bob-cli-bg (initializer suppression) and closed bob-cli-61 (refresh reorder timing). All-status CI/all-type search and last-week sweep found no duplicate; all active epic scopes inspected, none causal. This blocks independent XCTest acceptance for bg, whose initializer error is absent in this newer log. Small: precise one-line closure arity fix, plus meaningful compile/test verification. Use sase_repo, read AGENTS.md; run portable-check, best-effort Mac scratch bundle and typecheck-tests, and record current macOS CI evidence. Never call an uncompiled Swift change verified or weaken assertions. If CI must await the host commit, record the SHA/run after commit through supported SASE monitoring; the batch-7 tale will consume the independent landed result.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: A closure passed to a one-argument function omits its argument without using it; Swift emits a deterministic compile error before XCTest. GitHub Actions log and current source agree.

issue.creation_reason: Batch-7 land verification exposed a second compile error from the standalone Highlights-save commit after the save-key initializer diagnostic was fixed. No current task or active epic owns this distinct closure-arity defect.

payload.description: Distinct compile defects from the same save-scan commit; bi now masks bg XCTest acceptance
Adjacent RefsPanelModelTests compile fix at line 2402 in the same file

payload.entry: Independently verified resolved by batch-7 lander (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.land, 2026-10-25). bob-mac-capture a49a08b (landed with bob-cli-bc.7) changes RefsPanelModelTests.swift:2402 to waitForModel { _ in harness.library.snapshotRefreshGeneration > generation }, preserving the generation predicate and hidden-inspector assertion. master 569cb364 contains it; macOS CI https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40146325983 compiles every XCTest target, executes 3087 tests, and testHiddenLibraryRefreshDoesNotHydrateInspector passes (0.222 s). The run's only two failures are distinct tasks bob-cli-bv (RefsPanelModelTests:2312) and bob-cli-bw (CaptureInboxRouteChoiceModelTests:32), not this compile defect.
